tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter srung bdud btsan klu gsum gyi gtor 'bul ngag 'don bzhugs so/ 1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈ

gter srung bdud btsan klu gsum gyi gtor 'bul ngag 'don ni: hūm̐: bdud yul mkha' reg btsan ri dmar po dang: ne thang gong sngon so so'i gnas rnams nas: bdud nag rta can btsan rgod dmag chas can: klu rgyal mi sngon sprul pa bran dang bcas: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bdud tri ma ra du dza: shu la ra tsa yaṃ dza: nā ga du na phu dza: hūm̐: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga: gsang mchod sman rag gtor ma dang: dgra bo'i sha khrag don snying bcas: dgyes mchod skong ba'i mthun rdzas 'di: gter srung bdud btsan klu gsum gyi: 'khor dang bcas la 'bul gyis bzhes: thugs dam skongs la dgyes par rol: zab gter skyong ba'i srung ma mdzod: bdud tri ma ra du dza: shu la ra tsa yaṃ dza: nā ga du na phu dza: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum: bhyo: bdud yul mun pa'i gling dgu yi: bdud brag nag po'i rtsa shed na: bdud mtsho sngo nag me re re: bdud mtsho nag po'i nang rol na: bdud mkhar gnam du zing nge bar: mnga' bdag bdud kyi rgyal po ni: sku la bdud ber brtsegs mar gsol: phyag g.yas tri shul klad la bskor: g.yon pas bdud zhags glog ltar 'phen: chibs su bra nag rting dkar bcibs: 'khor du bdud dmag 'bum gyis bskor: dgra bo'i bdud du khyod bskos kyis: dgra bo'i srog la hur thum phob: bhyo: btsan ri zangs thang dmar po nas: btsan rgod shu ba srog len ni: sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol: bse phub dmar po rgyab tu bsnams: phyag g.yas spu gri reg chod dang: g.yon pas mdung dmar ba dan 'phyar: chibs su btsan rta dmar po bcibs: btsan rgod bya ra stong sdes bskor: sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan 'di'i: srog rtsa chod la snying khrag 'jibs: dus la bab bo mthu rtsal phyungs: bhyo: klu yul ne thang gong sngon nas: klu rje myos pa dbugs sdud ni: sku la dar sngon go zu gsol: phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu bsnams:

g.yon pas nad kyi rkyal pa phye: sbrul mjug chu rta sngon po bcibs: klu bdud gnyan rgod mang pos bskor: sbal sbrul sdom sdig cho 'phrul ston: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan la: klu nad sna tshogs char ltar phob: mdze rigs bco brgyad pho brang thob: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: ces pa'i gong 'og yig chung ni gzhan du shes so// mchod phreng sho lo ka gnyis po 'di med thabs med pa zhig byung tshe ha ya grī ba nā thas kha 'gengs su bgyis pa'o// chos rje gling pa'i gter ma'o// //
